run_multinode_training: run the multinode distributed training script for EgoVLPv2 on EPIC and Charades datasets using SLURM
run_single_node_training: run the EgoVLPv2 training script on a single node with multiple GPUs using torch multiprocessing
init_dataloaders: initialize train and validation dataloaders from config supporting single or multiple data loader configurations
handle_sigusr1: handle SLURM SIGUSR1 signal to requeue the job and exit gracefully on preemption
main_worker: initialize the distributed training worker including model, tokenizer, optimizer, scheduler, and trainer on a GPU
